We introduce the Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning Benchmark (URLB), a comprehensive evaluation framework for unsupervised RL methods. URLB comprises a diverse set of 12 tasks, categorized into three groups: (1) tasks requiring exploration, (2) tasks involving intrinsic motivation, and (3) tasks requiring both exploration and intrinsic motivation. Each task is designed to assess a specific aspect of unsupervised RL, and we provide a detailed analysis of the challenges and opportunities presented by these tasks. Furthermore, we conduct a thorough evaluation of 10 state-of-the-art unsupervised RL methods on the URLB benchmark, and our results reveal that no single method excels across all tasks. Instead, we observe that different methods perform best on distinct tasks, underscoring the need for a more nuanced understanding of the strengths and weaknesses of each approach.
